design.decision: On each trick, choose between shedding a dangerous honor (to protect a nil or avoid an overtrick) and trumping early with a high [♠] while still holding the led suit.
design.opponent: Revealed the first time your team plays off-suit; after that opponents can't count on your team's honors being trapped in a suit.
design.rationale: A free-play rule with two opposite uses (losing tricks or taking them), so it helps before any payoff is owned; the risk is that free-play options have measured near a blank (cb-free-after-made, cc-any-suit-first-two), and this tests whether a version limited to certain cards does better.
design.draftText: Your team can play [10]s through [A]s even when it can follow suit

critic.concerns: Near-duplicate of rc-honor-free (range [10]-[A] vs [J]-[A]); keep only one, and free-play rules have measured near blank so far.
